frozen_assignment: saved42sensorfeatures and training standardizer, nearest frozen4centers; no generated-data fitting
permutation_rule: permute requested IDs within EXACT target RUL only; preserve requested and output marginals at eachRUL; tests only all/31-60; all candidates reported
negative_control: A has no prototype input; use B saved requested IDs as PSEUDO labels on paired existing A sample indices; never call them real A conditions
sync_RUL_support: prior aligned train-validation real-matched RUL sets per pair, restricted to generated requested groups with>=3samples eachRUL; report exact sets; equalRULmean
bootstrap_rule: generated windows within exactRUL and requested class; paired A/B row indices; no invented generated engineID; conditional-on-saved-batch uncertainty only
interpretation: CMI tests any response, accuracy tests intended label correspondence, synchrony tests retained real contrast. Partial response is not proof of useful downstream generation; lack of significance is not proof of zero effect; checkpoints/seeds share sampling noise and are not independent replications.
